title: Safety Signals to Verify NetOps Agents with Action-Level Granularity
abstract: arXiv:2609.14422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic Network Operations (NetOps) are an emerging paradigm promising to enable workload-aware, self-adjustable, and reliable autonomous networks. While agents have proven their value in incident summarization and telemetry signal extraction, their effectiveness as autonomous control-loop engines heavily relies on their long-horizon reliability. One such setting is the datacenter fabric, where an agent must respond to alarms and operator intents while abstaining from high-risk actions that may cause or extend downtime. Abstention, however, presupposes that an action's impact is known pre-execution, which necessitates a per-action ground truth that NetOps agent benchmarks do not provide. We construct such a ground truth for the network repair task of NetArena. translated_title: 具有动作级粒度的安全信号用于验证网络运维智能体
translated_abstract: 代理式网络运维是一种新兴范式，有望实现负载感知、自调节且可靠的自治网络。虽然智能体已在事件总结和遥测信号提取方面证明了其价值，但它们作为自治控制回路引擎的有效性在很大程度上依赖于其长时程可靠性。其中一个典型场景是数据中心网络结构，智能体必须响应告警和操作员意图，同时避免执行可能造成或延长停机时间的高风险动作。然而，“避免执行”的前提是动作的影响在执行前是已知的，这需要每个动作的基准真值，而当前的NetOps智能体基准测试并未提供这一点。我们为NetArena的网络修复任务构建了这样的基准真值。通过对模拟网络进行符号化重放，并在每一轮都与环境进行验证，可以得到每个动作的精确价值。从动作级价值出发，我们推导出两个预执行（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对模拟网络进行符号化重放，为NetArena网络修复任务构建了动作级基准真值，并据此推导出安全信号，使NetOps智能体能够在执行前识别并避免高风险动作。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs action-level ground truth for the NetArena network repair task via symbolic replay of the emulated network, deriving safety signals that enable NetOps agents to abstain from high-risk actions before execution.
